title: The decade ruler under the things it took

members.role: the ground: on the lag's word ('it took more than a decade') the strip enters at the right edge, scrolls the earlier decades past and lands framed on the decades the lag lands in, then holds
the things it took, one chip per named thing on its own word, in a ROW ABOVE the ruler - no year on a chip, no pin, no leader to a tick (the ruler dates nothing; a year on a chip over it is a WARN)

does: A lag of years as a ground: the ruler scrolls the decades past and settles, then the named things land in a row above it, one per word - the time is felt, and nothing is pinned to a year.

use_when.shape: dates + named things: a span of decades and 2-4 things that arrived across it
use_when.use: a lag of years between a cause and its payoff ('it took more than a decade for smartphones, streaming, cloud computing'; 'the fibre came first') - the ruler is the time, the chips are the things
use_when.dont: a single date (an axis tag, A10); a chip pinned to a year or labelled with one (the ruler dates nothing - s109 (c)); more than four decades in the window

source: P71 T14 (VERIFY.md row T32: Bravos BOOM jx3Ll-GJtMY 05:50.5-06:10 - the ruler scrolls from 1980 and settles on 2000-2020, the chips pop in a row above it; no pins).
